Keybinding.Name: Follow / stop following
Keybinding.Hint: With a token selected: pick a token for it to follow. Press again with the same token selected to stop following.

Dialog.Title: Follow which token?
Dialog.Intro: Choose the token that {name} should follow.
Dialog.None: There are no other tokens on this scene to follow.

Notify.NoToken: Token Follower: select a token first.
Notify.Rebound: Token Follower: F is already used by "{action}", so the follow key was set to Ctrl+F. You can change it under Configure Controls.
Notify.NoFreeKey: Token Follower: both F and Ctrl+F are already used. Set a key for "Follow / stop following" under Configure Controls.
Notify.Loop: {leader} is already following {follower}; a token can't follow its own follower.
